prose: CM-N is for duel-wielding battles. In this lesson, two lumens are matched up 2-sabers versus single-saber to help students learn how to navigate switching between hands. To make this an effective lesson for all, we made the CM only 6 steps, similar to CM-A to help ease everyone into using 2 hands. Notation below for Lumen 1 is noted with which hand is used to strike with each saber. L stands for Left. R stands for Right hand.
